paragraphs: From Kilkenny Government Buildings on Hebron Road, depart and take the 1st right to continue along Hebron Road for about 335 metres.
At the roundabout, take the 1st exit left onto Lintown Avenue and continue for roughly 470 metres to the next roundabout.
At the roundabout, take the exit left onto Johnswell Road and follow it for about 350 metres.
Turn left into Beechlawns.
At the end of the road turn right, staying within the Beechlawns estate.
Continue through the estate and find a safe spot to perform a U-turn for turnabout practice.
Repeat the turnabout once more if the examiner asks, then make your way back out through Beechlawns.
At the end of Beechlawns, turn left onto Johnswell Road and drive for around 640 metres up to the roundabout.
At the roundabout, go straight through taking the slight left exit onto the Kilkenny Ring Road for roughly 500 metres.
At the next roundabout, take the exit left onto Hebron Road and follow it for about 520 metres.
At the roundabout, take the 1st exit left, staying on Hebron Road for a further 540 metres.
At the next roundabout, take the exit left onto Castlecomer Road.
Take the 1st right into John's Green.
The road becomes Wolfe Tone Street, so keep straight, then bear slight right and left as the street bends.
Cross Saint Francis Bridge onto the Kilkenny Central Access Scheme Road.
Turn right into Vicar Street.
Pull in safely on a quiet stretch for parking practice, then move off again.
Continue and turn right onto Green Street.
Follow Green Street as it becomes New Road for about 300 metres up to the roundabout.
At the roundabout, take the exit slight left onto Castlecomer Road and drive for around 470 metres to the next roundabout.
At the roundabout, take the exit left onto Hebron Road heading back toward the test centre.
If directed, turn right into a side road off Hebron Road, complete a U-turn, then turn left back onto Hebron Road for reverse or turnabout practice.
Follow Hebron Road, Castlecomer Road and New Road back around, passing near Green's Bridge.
Return toward Kilkenny Government Buildings on Hebron Road to finish the route.
